content.title: 空场异常｜物质扩张与片名停留
content.summary: 先建立有序空场和一个物件，再让单一材质异常扩散并留给标题空间。

quick_start.input_format: 有序空场＋锚定物件＋单一异常＋原创片名
quick_start.recommended_input: 无人小天文台、一台黄铜望远镜、其下的一张纸质星图；望远镜目镜处出现唯一连续霜线。
required_anchors: 标题不被误写成异常产物
usage_steps: 把示例主体、场景和表层元素替换为原创概念。
让每个必需锚点和 Creative DNA 不可变条件都能在画面因果链中被看见。
选择 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 模板，只填写已声明的可替换项。
生成前检查时长、事件顺序、镜头连续性、声音和反复制约束。
applicable_scope: 先建立有序空场和一个物件，再让单一材质异常扩散并留给标题空间。
能够保留全部必需锚点的原创 4–15 秒短片。
需要可复用因果视频结构的 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 项目。
not_suitable_for: 要求复制来源人物、场景、道具、对白或镜头顺序的任务。
无法在目标时长内展示全部必需锚点的概念。
缺少紧凑因果链的长篇讲解或无关多地点叙事。

creative_dna.mechanism: An ordered empty location and one marked mundane object create a baseline. A single traceable material anomaly spreads in relation to that locus, then the camera holds the changed evidence under a distinct overlaid original title; the material is not assumed to generate the title or to have an unseen exact cause.

invariants.rule: Establish an orderly, visibly unoccupied location and isolate one ordinary marked object within it.
invariants.purpose: Fixes the visual baseline and gives attention a concrete locus.
invariants.ablation_failure: Many anomalies or shifting geography make the later change arbitrary.

invariants.rule: Introduce one connected material anomaly that grows in a stable area while the camera proves its relation to the marked object/location; do not assert an unseen cause.
invariants.purpose: Allows unease to escalate through visible evidence.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated jump scares or disconnected patches break the single-clue mechanism.

invariants.rule: Use short credits before the anomaly peaks; place a distinct original legible title as overlay on a held evidence composition.
invariants.purpose: Maintains title-sequence hierarchy without pretending the material spells the letters.
invariants.ablation_failure: Illegible moving text or title appearing before evidence blunts the payoff.

slots.name: empty_location
slots.constraint: Stable, orderly place with no visible person.

slots.name: marked_object
slots.constraint: One visually distinguishable object that attracts attention.

slots.name: material_anomaly
slots.constraint: One connected progressive change, with source not falsely asserted.

slots.name: evidence_view
slots.constraint: View that proves changed material relative to stable setting.

slots.name: credits
slots.constraint: Short invented readable overlays before final reveal.

slots.name: title
slots.constraint: Original legible text separate from physical anomaly.

slots.name: sound
slots.constraint: Original sparse sound arc, not attributed to unheard source.

anti_copy_exclusions: No pear, black bow, dinner table, orchard, wine-red tabletop spill or source title/credit names.
No claim that the source liquid is blood or that the pear causes it.
No exact table-tracking/plate-overhead composition transfer or source serif layout.

instantiations.concept: In an original empty observatory, one abandoned paper star chart lies beneath a brass telescope; a small frost crystal appears on the eyepiece and spreads continuously along the connected brass tube and ring mount; a final overhead view holds the frosted instrument while the original title 'COLD MERIDIAN' overlays it.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Empty observatory, marked star chart, one continuous frost growth on brass instrument, original title COLD MERIDIAN.

instantiations.concept: In an original deserted ferry terminal, one unclaimed blue luggage tag hangs from a bench; a single connected wet drag mark appears at its base and extends continuously across the same tiled concourse; a stable high view holds the trace and the original title 'LAST DEPARTURE' as an overlay.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Deserted ferry terminal, blue luggage tag, one continuous wet drag mark across fixed tiles, original title LAST DEPARTURE.

failure_modes.failure: Many spooky objects appear without a single tracked anomaly.
failure_modes.repair: Keep one marked object and one continuous material trace.

failure_modes.failure: Title text is shown as if the material magically forms letters.
failure_modes.repair: Use a clean overlaid title after evidence is clear.

failure_modes.failure: Space resets between details and final view.
failure_modes.repair: Repeat fixed landmarks and show the anomaly on the same object or floor.
